tasks.title: Publish an agent-ready roadmap and the initialized wiki
tasks.outcome: Give every known workstream an issue, a dependency order, and an honest published wiki.
acceptance: Create bounded child issues and link the existing tracking issues without duplicating the core implementation.
Publish a dependency-checked manifest, execution waves, agent handoff template and cost/risk tiers.
Publish wiki pages with navigation, installation troubleshooting and explicit source-preview status.
Verify issue links, graph integrity and the pushed wiki revision; keep source docs in a separate PR.
validation: python3 scripts/check-plan.py
Verify GitHub issue/milestone links and wiki page links against live responses.
tasks.out_of_scope: No product code changes, merging the core PR, new agents, releases or Reddit publication.

tasks.title: Define snapshot, query and comparison contracts before parallel implementation
tasks.outcome: Freeze small shared interfaces so independently assigned agents do not invent incompatible data models.
acceptance: Write an ADR covering Snapshot completeness, index/worktree/HEAD identity and stable event ordering.
Specify a paginated read/query interface and a structured comparison result with synthetic examples.
Specify JSON compatibility and migration policy, wall-clock versus elapsed timing, and overlapping-command semantics.
Name exact follow-up owners/files; obtain maintainer acceptance before consumers implement the contract.
validation: Review examples for unborn/detached HEAD, incomplete capture, same-time events and concurrent shells.
Documentation-only ADR; do not add implementation-mirroring tests.
tasks.out_of_scope: No speculative workspace split, daemon, schema implementation or TUI code.

tasks.title: Add reproducible release-binary capture benchmarks
tasks.outcome: Measure actual overhead before selecting optimizations.
acceptance: Provide isolated non-Git, small-repo and large-repo fixtures with documented file counts and sizes.
Measure startup, hook start/end and fingerprint-heavy capture separately with warmups and repetitions.
Report median/p95, toolchain, OS, machine and commit; persist only synthetic benchmark results.
Do not make hardware-specific thresholds mandatory in shared CI; document the reproduction command.
validation: Run the harness on macOS in release mode and show valid raw samples and summary.
Run fixture creation/cleanup twice; confirm no user repo/history is modified.
tasks.out_of_scope: No performance claims without results, no production optimization and no daemon.

tasks.title: Expand interactive zsh regression coverage
tasks.outcome: Expose shell integration regressions before enabling capture for daily work.
acceptance: Cover cd across repositories, nested shells, leading-space commands and repeated init in real PTYs.
Cover failed commands, Ctrl-C, unavailable binary and database locks while checking exit status and responsiveness.
Assert session separation and no double-recording of explicit nivra run.
Use temporary HOME/ZDOTDIR/data fixtures; report newly discovered production bugs explicitly instead of weakening assertions.
validation: python3 scripts/test-zsh.py on macOS and Linux
cargo test --locked
tasks.out_of_scope: No new shell support or major hook redesign; unrelated failures become focused issues.

tasks.title: Implement validated local configuration loading
tasks.outcome: Give later privacy and retention tasks one documented source of configuration.
acceptance: Add a versioned TOML configuration with conservative defaults and explicit config-path precedence.
Validate known keys, durations and size limits; useful CLI errors and fail-open hook behavior for invalid configuration.
Define settings for enabled capture, Git enablement, limits, exclusions and retention without claiming unimplemented consumers work.
Expose resolved non-sensitive settings through a config command; test missing and malformed files.
validation: Unit tests for precedence/defaults/unknown keys and invalid limits.
CLI tests with isolated config/data directories; full Rust checks.
tasks.out_of_scope: No environment value capture, full patch/output capture, sync settings or hidden writes to shell startup files.

tasks.title: Harden SQLite migrations, concurrent initialization and private storage
tasks.outcome: Make future schema changes and simultaneous shell capture safe for existing history.
acceptance: Introduce transactional, versioned migrations with fixtures for v1, interrupted migration and newer unknown versions.
Make concurrent initialization and writes deterministic; capture still fails open under contention.
Review directory/database symlink handling and prevent accidentally changing permissions on a shared/home directory.
Document durability and journal decisions; prove existing events and marks survive upgrades.
validation: Migration round-trip and failure rollback tests on fixture databases.
Concurrent-process, locked-database and unsafe-path tests; macOS/Linux CI.
tasks.out_of_scope: No destructive reset fallback, background service, encryption promise or unrelated read API redesign.

tasks.title: Enforce a total capture budget with explicit partial snapshots
tasks.outcome: Bound shell interference across Git subprocesses and file hashing, not just each Git query.
acceptance: Apply a shared deadline, output cap and aggregate file/byte budget per capture.
Stop or skip work safely and encode partial-snapshot reasons through the accepted contract.
Handle slow Git, unreadable files, symlinks, non-UTF-8 paths and file growth without indefinite capture work.
Publish before/after benchmark data and preserve fail-open behavior; document any unbounded OS edge cases honestly.
validation: Deterministic slow-process and oversized-fixture tests with generous upper-bound assertions.
Repeat A02 benchmarks; verify partial results cannot be presented as complete marks.
tasks.out_of_scope: No daemon or async redesign unless a separate ADR and issue are approved.

tasks.title: Add configurable exclusions and strengthen pre-storage redaction
tasks.outcome: Keep sensitive workflows out of history with explicit, testable controls.
acceptance: Implement documented command/repository exclusion rules before persistence and define ignore-next consumption semantics.
Add synthetic fixtures for quoted/multiline assignments, flags, credential URLs, false positives and oversized inputs.
Verify secrets never occur in database bytes, sidecars or diagnostic output; never use real credentials.
Preserve pause/resume behavior across shells and clearly document heuristic limits.
validation: Redaction fixture tests and raw-storage leak assertions.
End-to-end tests for exclusions, pause, ignore-next and concurrent shells.
tasks.out_of_scope: No claim of perfect secret detection, automatic historical scrubbing or posting private reports.

tasks.title: Separate command elapsed time from wall-clock event timestamps
tasks.outcome: Show trustworthy command duration even when the wall clock changes.
acceptance: Store event timestamps separately from monotonic elapsed duration for explicit runs.
Define and implement a supported zsh elapsed-time transport that excludes capture work where measurable.
Preserve incomplete events and old database compatibility; do not invent a duration when timing is unavailable.
Document nested shell, suspend/resume and interrupted-command semantics.
validation: Injectable clock/unit fixtures for backwards/forwards wall-clock changes.
PTY and explicit-run duration tests plus migration coverage.
tasks.out_of_scope: No timeline ordering solely by monotonic timestamps from unrelated processes.

tasks.title: Extract a paginated read API for events, sessions and marks
tasks.outcome: Let CLI and TUI consume the same bounded queries instead of directly issuing ad-hoc SQL.
acceptance: Implement stable cursor pagination using the A01 contract, including equal timestamps and incomplete events.
Expose typed event detail, session summary and repository-scoped mark queries.
Separate query operations from schema mutations; do not silently create history just to inspect a missing database.
Preserve current events output compatibility and add deterministic synthetic fixtures.
validation: Multi-page tests without duplicated/missing rows, empty DB and repository isolation.
Read-only/locked database cases; full Rust checks.
tasks.out_of_scope: No TUI, search syntax, new capture schema or unbounded loading of entire history.

tasks.title: Add event inspection and named-mark listing commands
tasks.outcome: Inspect one observed event and discover existing baselines from the CLI.
acceptance: Add show by unambiguous event ID/prefix with text and JSON output, before/after state and incomplete status.
Add repository-scoped marks listing with names and capture timestamps.
Reject ambiguous/missing IDs with actionable messages and safe exit codes.
Use the shared query API and escape control characters in metadata.
validation: CLI fixtures for completed/incomplete events, ambiguous prefixes and per-repo marks.
Verify JSON shape and empty-list behavior.
tasks.out_of_scope: No command replay, mark deletion, database schema redesign or TUI.

tasks.title: Add session browsing and composable timeline search
tasks.outcome: Find a failed command in the right development session without loading the entire database.
acceptance: Add sessions summaries and event filters for text, failed status, repo, branch, session and since time.
Define time-zone/relative-time parsing and combination semantics; bind all SQL parameters.
Reuse stable pagination and preserve structured JSON output.
Provide clear empty and invalid-filter responses with synthetic examples.
validation: Combined filters across sessions/repos; same timestamps and special characters.
Query-plan or bounded-query evidence on a large synthetic history.
tasks.out_of_scope: No replacement for Atuin, fuzzy search engine or external indexing service.

tasks.title: Implement structured state comparison shared by CLI and TUI
tasks.outcome: Give every viewer the same interpretation of before/after state and uncertainty.
acceptance: Extract comparison into a testable typed result with file transitions, branch/HEAD changes and completeness warnings.
Handle dirty-to-dirty edits, deletions, renames, unborn/detached HEAD and reversed intervals explicitly.
Define command-boundary inclusion and overlapping-event presentation; retain observations-only language.
Version/document JSON and keep existing CLI workflows usable.
validation: Fixture-driven comparison tests for each transition and partial snapshots.
End-to-end mark/diff tests across repos and equal timestamps.
tasks.out_of_scope: No stored full file contents, causal diagnosis, Git restoration or TUI rendering.

tasks.title: Expand comparisons to staged and committed Git changes
tasks.outcome: A commit or index-only change should not disappear behind an unchanged worktree status.
acceptance: Represent index and worktree identity according to A01 and migrate stored snapshots compatibly.
Report committed file names and insertion/deletion stats when historical objects are available, without storing patches by default.
Handle binary files, renamed files, staging-only changes, unavailable objects and detached HEAD honestly.
Respect the total capture/read budgets and never invoke external diff drivers or textconv.
validation: Temporary Git repositories exercising add/stage/unstage/commit/rename and missing-object cases.
Repeat relevant capture benchmarks and migration tests.
tasks.out_of_scope: No full diff storage, source recovery or causal claims; optional full diffs remain a deferred design.

tasks.title: Implement explicit retention and safe garbage collection
tasks.outcome: Let users bound local history without silently losing marked baselines.
acceptance: Define retention cutoffs and pinning rules for marks/incomplete events before deleting records.
Add gc with a dry-run summary and transactional execution over the dedicated data store.
Respect active readers/writers, remove orphaned rows safely and document disk-space reclamation separately.
Test disabled/default retention and exact cutoff semantics; no automatic sweeping before policy is explicit.
validation: Synthetic histories covering protected marks, incomplete events, boundary timestamps and rollback.
Concurrent reader/writer and idempotent dry-run/execution tests.
tasks.out_of_scope: No deletion outside the Nivra database, undocumented default purges or shell-startup cleanup.

tasks.title: Improve doctor and installation troubleshooting
tasks.outcome: Explain build-versus-install, hook activation and capture failures without misleading success checks.
acceptance: Report binary location/version, configured data path, schema health and required tools with clear remediation.
Add an explicit session marker/handshake so hook status is reported only when verifiable.
Produce a sanitized report suitable for issues; do not leak command history or home paths by default.
Document cargo install, PATH/rehash, unloading hooks and temporary demo-data behavior.
validation: CLI tests for missing Git, invalid config, inaccessible data and inactive hooks.
PTY verification of actual hook activation and installation examples.
tasks.out_of_scope: No automatic shell-file modification or automatic transmission of diagnostic reports.

tasks.title: Polish terminal output for narrow widths and accessibility
tasks.outcome: Keep long temporary paths and Unicode metadata readable on real terminals.
acceptance: Centralize rendering with terminal-width-aware path display and explicit full-path access.
Honor NO_COLOR/non-TTY output; never rely on color alone for status.
Escape control sequences and handle narrow windows, long commands and Unicode widths.
Keep JSON values unshortened and document stable versus human-readable output.
validation: Representative 40/80/120-column rendering fixtures plus redirected output.
Control-sequence/Unicode/path tests and a manual terminal check.
tasks.out_of_scope: No fake demo data, full theme engine or changes to stored metadata.

tasks.title: Implement read-only current port inspection on macOS
tasks.outcome: Show what currently listens on a port and its process/project when observable.
acceptance: Add ports and port commands with port, address, PID, executable and cwd/repository where available.
Use a documented macOS provider with bounded subprocess behavior and injectable parser fixtures.
Handle IPv4/IPv6, duplicate sockets, permission restrictions and disappearing processes.
Mark unavailable fields explicitly; do not claim a historical command started a process without evidence.
validation: Parser fixtures and a controlled loopback listener smoke test on macOS.
Verify no process is terminated or signaled by inspection.
tasks.out_of_scope: No runtime history, root escalation, process ancestry guesses, restart or Linux provider.

tasks.title: Add safe, explicit port-owner termination
tasks.outcome: Allow an intentional stop action without terminating a reused PID or unrelated service.
acceptance: Revalidate PID identity and socket ownership immediately before signaling; handle races explicitly.
Default to graceful termination with bounded wait; escalation must be an explicit separate choice.
Show the exact target and require confirmation; noninteractive calls require explicit intent flags.
Test only child processes created by the test; refusal and permission failures are actionable.
validation: Fake-provider PID reuse/race tests and isolated child-process stop tests.
Confirm inspection never signals and cancellation never mutates.
tasks.out_of_scope: No arbitrary process killing, sudo, service-manager changes or automatic restart.

tasks.title: Build the TUI terminal lifecycle and application shell
tasks.outcome: Provide a safe terminal foundation before adding timeline panels.
acceptance: Use one maintainer-selected Rust TUI stack; document the small app/event/render interface.
Restore terminal state on normal exit, errors and panic paths; define Ctrl-C behavior.
Fall back to useful text output when stdin/stdout are not TTYs; preserve existing CLI commands.
Support resize, help and clean empty/error states using the shared read API.
validation: PTY smoke tests for enter/quit/resize/error and terminal restoration.
CI-friendly render tests without requiring a graphical desktop.
tasks.out_of_scope: No timeline search implementation, event inspector or repository architecture rewrite.

tasks.title: Implement keyboard-driven timeline browsing in the TUI
tasks.outcome: Browse real command events quickly by session and failure state.
acceptance: Render paginated events with time, duration, exit/incomplete state and repository/session context.
Add documented up/down/page navigation and session/search/failure filters.
Keep selection stable through refresh and paging; show loading/empty/error states.
Ensure narrow terminals, long commands and non-color status remain usable.
validation: Deterministic render/input-state tests with synthetic events.
Real PTY flow exercising filters, paging and clean quit.
tasks.out_of_scope: No full history fetch, command execution or detail/compare panel implementation.

tasks.title: Add event details and baseline comparison panels to the TUI
tasks.outcome: Make the passing-baseline-to-failure investigation visible in one terminal interface.
acceptance: Open event details with enter and render before/after state, exit status and incomplete warnings.
Allow selecting a named mark and comparing with a selected snapshot or now through shared comparison logic.
Display file transitions and intervening commands with clear focus/back/help navigation.
Do not infer causality, replay commands, or hide partial-capture warnings.
validation: Render/input-state fixtures for baseline, changed files, partial events and missing marks.
Record a real temporary-repository walkthrough using stored events.
tasks.out_of_scope: No process controls, clipboard integration or duplicate comparison implementation.

tasks.title: Add a deterministic why command for repeated success/failure checks
tasks.outcome: Find the last successful equivalent command before a failure and summarize observed changes.
acceptance: Define exact command/repository matching, time range and session scope without AI heuristics.
Select a successful baseline before the failure, using comparable pre-execution snapshots and explaining unavailable cases.
Present the shared state comparison and command interval with clear observation-only wording.
Support text/JSON and never auto-execute either command.
validation: Fixtures for repeated successes/failures, redacted commands, missing baselines and cross-repo histories.
CLI tests proving deterministic selection and no execution side effects.
tasks.out_of_scope: No AI dependency, causal diagnosis or approximate secret-sensitive command matching.

tasks.title: Complete a documented daily-use alpha evaluation
tasks.outcome: Use real development sessions before presenting the product as ready for broader use.
acceptance: Maintainer runs the alpha for seven real days and records a dated checklist without private history.
Evaluate capture overhead, shell reliability, recovery, TUI usability and privacy controls.
Open reproducible issues for findings; resolve release-blocking data loss, shell interference and credential leaks.
Publish a supported-platform matrix and limitations grounded in observed results.
validation: Dated manual evidence, benchmark references and linked regression issues.
Automated tests supplement but do not replace elapsed real-world use.
tasks.out_of_scope: No fabricated dogfooding, instant completion by an agent or public release approval.

tasks.title: Build reproducible preview release artifacts and checksums
tasks.outcome: Produce downloadable binaries tied to an exact reviewed source revision.
acceptance: Define a supported target matrix, tag/version checks, minimal workflow permissions and pinned actions.
Produce archives with license/version metadata and SHA-256 checksums; test packaging without publishing.
Document provenance/signing choices and never claim notarization or signatures that are absent.
Require an explicit maintainer release action; do not publish credentials or overwrite existing releases.
validation: Dry-run matrix builds and archive/checksum verification.
Inspect artifact names, binary versions and workflow permissions.
tasks.out_of_scope: No automatic tag push, public release, crate publication or signing-certificate acquisition.

tasks.title: Verify clean-machine install, upgrade and uninstall flows
tasks.outcome: Prevent another successful build followed by command-not-found for first-time users.
acceptance: Verify source and release-binary installation on the supported clean environments with no pre-existing Nivra PATH entry.
Document PATH setup, rehash, hook opt-in, upgrades and unloading/uninstalling without silently deleting history.
Run the working-to-broken demo against the installed binary and record actual platform results.
Document unsupported platforms and interrupted-install recovery.
validation: Clean VM/container evidence where appropriate, plus actual macOS install validation.
nivra --version, --help and isolated demo from outside the checkout.
tasks.out_of_scope: No unreviewed curl-pipe-shell installer or claim that a container validates macOS.

tasks.title: Produce the real demo recording and public-preview materials
tasks.outcome: Show the actual debugging payoff within 15–20 seconds.
acceptance: Record a passing check, mark, real edit, failure and TUI comparison using the released/identified candidate.
Remove personal paths and credentials; retain truthful command results and label the tested revision.
Update README with a readable still, accessible text transcript and a reproducible demo command.
Draft launch text with limitations, measured overhead and specific feedback questions; inspect current community rules before posting.
validation: Replay the demo from a clean temporary repository and inspect the resulting video/still.
Verify all download/docs links and compare claims to the candidate behavior.
tasks.out_of_scope: No Reddit posting, fabricated results, stock TUI screenshots, user-count claims or automatic promotion.

tasks.title: Run the public-preview release gate
tasks.outcome: Keep the final launch decision distinct from delegated implementation work.
acceptance: Maintainer verifies all M1/M2 acceptance evidence, security findings and candidate CI results.
Verify source tag, artifact checksums, installation instructions and wiki match the candidate revision.
Record go/no-go with unresolved risks; do not close the gate with missing evidence.
Publish release or community posts only when the user explicitly authorizes those final actions.
validation: Manual checklist referencing exact commits, artifacts and accepted risks.
tasks.out_of_scope: No autonomous public launch, fabricated approvals or bypass of branch protection.

tasks.title: Add a checked, manual wiki publication workflow
tasks.outcome: Keep reviewed Markdown sources and GitHub Wiki pages from silently diverging.
acceptance: Add a dry-run exporter that rewrites local page links, validates page targets and preserves any unrelated wiki pages.
Include a source revision marker and reject unresolved links before publication.
Provide a maintainer-invoked publish procedure that diffs before pushing and does not need a persistent write token in CI.
Validate plan/wiki links in documentation CI; avoid overwriting manual wiki edits without a reviewed diff.
validation: Temporary source/wiki fixtures for .md links, anchors, missing pages and unrelated content.
Dry-run against the current wiki with no remote write.
tasks.out_of_scope: No recurring bot, secrets in repository, automatic publishing on every PR or product changes.

tasks.title: Add Bash integration using the accepted capture contract
tasks.outcome: Offer Bash users the same event model without disrupting existing prompt integrations.
acceptance: Specify supported Bash versions and prompt/preexec strategy before implementation.
Preserve existing prompt commands, exit codes, multiline commands and session isolation.
Honor exclusions, pause and explicit-run deduplication; failures remain non-blocking to user commands.
Provide install/unload instructions and PTY tests on supported platforms.
validation: Bash PTY matrix with failures, pipelines, signals and multiple prompt integrations.
tasks.out_of_scope: No shell replacement, automatic rc editing or unverified Bash-version claims.

tasks.title: Add Fish integration using the accepted capture contract
tasks.outcome: Offer Fish users the same local capture and privacy controls.
acceptance: Specify supported Fish versions and event hooks, then implement opt-in integration.
Preserve status, job behavior, nested sessions and explicit-run deduplication.
Support idempotent init/unload and bounded fail-open capture.
Add PTY coverage and installation documentation.
validation: Fish PTY matrix for success/failure, signals, spaces and missing Nivra binary.
tasks.out_of_scope: No global shell configuration modification or unrelated capture redesign.

tasks.title: Add a Linux port provider and publish a tested support matrix
tasks.outcome: Extend current port inspection with honest Linux capability reporting.
acceptance: Implement a provider behind the existing typed interface and define required tools/proc access.
Cover IPv4/IPv6, permission restrictions, PID races and cwd unavailability.
Preserve read-only inspection and ensure safe-stop identity checks apply consistently.
Publish tested distro/kernel/tool assumptions and graceful unavailable states.
validation: Linux parser fixtures and isolated real listener tests in CI.
tasks.out_of_scope: No root requirement, full process monitor or historical process attribution.

tasks.title: Specify a versioned portable session bundle and import threat model
tasks.outcome: Design export/import once before implementations start storing incompatible archives.
acceptance: Specify .nivra metadata and event/snapshot encoding, limits, versioning and repository/path handling.
Define export privacy defaults, explicit review, incomplete-event semantics and no command replay.
Define importer protections for path traversal, symlinks, zip bombs, duplicates and unknown versions.
Provide synthetic valid/invalid fixtures and create separately scoped implementation acceptance criteria.
validation: Maintainer review of format examples and threat model; fixture-schema validation.
tasks.out_of_scope: No network sharing, custom binary format, implementation before ADR acceptance or .rewind branding.

tasks.title: Implement local bundle export with explicit privacy preview
tasks.outcome: Create a portable selected session without silently exposing the whole history.
acceptance: Export explicit session/time/repo selections using the accepted .nivra format and enforce size limits.
Show a reviewable metadata/command summary and allow cancellation before writing.
Apply export redaction/path policy and label heuristic limits; output never uploads anywhere.
Write atomically and handle existing destination files without silent overwrite.
validation: Golden synthetic archives, range-boundary/redaction tests and failed-write cleanup tests.
tasks.out_of_scope: No upload, remote viewer, replay or automatic inclusion of full source patches.

tasks.title: Implement safe, read-only inspection of imported bundles
tasks.outcome: Inspect a shared reproduction without trusting its paths, commands or schema.
acceptance: Validate format/version/size limits and reject traversal, symlink and decompression abuse.
Open imported data in an isolated read-only context without merging into live capture history.
Render untrusted metadata safely and preserve explicit incomplete/unsupported states.
Never execute commands, fetch URLs or restore files from imported data.
validation: Malicious synthetic archives and resource-limit tests plus export/open round-trip.
tasks.out_of_scope: No auto-merge, replay, source restoration or network requests.

tasks.title: Design runtime observation, ownership and resource budgets
tasks.outcome: Define the evidence needed to connect a command, process and port over time.
acceptance: Specify process identity beyond PID, observation gaps, ancestry confidence and permissions per platform.
Choose an observation strategy from measurements, including explicit lifecycle and resource budgets.
Specify storage/event contracts, retention and how runtime state enters snapshot comparisons.
Split implementation into bounded child issues before accepting the design; no daemon by default without evidence.
validation: Review synthetic timelines for PID reuse, detached jobs, missed exits and ambiguous ownership.
tasks.out_of_scope: No production runtime monitor, daemon installation or unsupported historical attribution.

tasks.title: Implement a bounded runtime timeline pilot
tasks.outcome: Prove process/port history with one accepted platform before broadening it.
acceptance: Split this gated work package into S/M implementation issues using the accepted D01 contract before coding.
Implement one platform provider, retention-aware runtime events and explicit observation gaps.
Add port history and comparison integration without guessing command ownership.
Publish overhead and controlled-process evidence; enable collection only through explicit opt-in.
validation: Controlled process tree/socket lifecycle tests, PID-reuse fixtures and resource benchmarks.
tasks.out_of_scope: Not ready for a single low-cost-agent implementation; no unbounded polling or cross-platform promises.

tasks.title: Design and implement explicit, race-safe process restart
tasks.outcome: Restart only a known command with reviewable cwd/arguments and trustworthy ownership.
acceptance: Require captured provenance and fresh identity/ownership checks before stopping a target.
Preview exact command/cwd and require explicit confirmation; refuse redacted or incomplete commands.
Define environment handling without persisting secret environment dumps.
Handle failed restart without silently looping or escalating privileges.
validation: Owned child-process fixtures for PID reuse, missing cwd, redacted commands and restart failure.
tasks.out_of_scope: No arbitrary service restart, sudo, invisible shell execution or inferred provenance.

tasks.title: Decide optional encrypted sync architecture and threat model
tasks.outcome: Evaluate whether optional sync is worth implementing while preserving a complete local product.
acceptance: Define devices, keys/recovery/revocation, opaque server storage and authenticated versioned protocol.
Specify conflict/deletion/retention behavior, quotas, replay protection and metadata leakage.
Compare reviewed cryptographic libraries; require specialist review before implementation.
Produce explicit client/server child issues and a go/no-go decision; declining sync is an acceptable documented outcome.
validation: Threat-model review and synthetic multi-device scenarios; no invented cryptography.
tasks.out_of_scope: No mandatory account, server, telemetry, cloud credentials or production deployment.

tasks.title: Implement the approved optional sync client and self-hosted server
files: Future client/server modules defined by E01
tasks.outcome: Track the future implementation without pretending an unaccepted protocol is agent-ready.
acceptance: Do not assign for coding until E01 is accepted and this work package is split into bounded protocol/storage/client/server tasks.
Keep local-only workflows fully functional with sync disabled or unavailable.
Enforce client-side encryption, limits and deletion semantics from the accepted threat model.
Require independent security review and integration tests before any deployment or release.
validation: Protocol conformance, adversarial server/client fixtures and security review evidence defined by E01.
tasks.out_of_scope: Not an implementation prompt yet; no deployment, accounts or secrets provisioning in this issue.

tasks.title: Design sanitized share previews and a read-only session viewer
tasks.outcome: Let developers review exactly what would be shared before a portable session leaves their machine.
acceptance: Specify review/redaction UX, path/identifier sanitization and residual disclosure risks.
Design a local read-only viewer first, including accessibility and hostile imported content boundaries.
Define optional hosting/link expiry/deletion separately; no upload without explicit user action.
Create bounded viewer and share implementation issues after the design is accepted.
validation: Synthetic preview examples, XSS/control-sequence threat review and accessibility acceptance checklist.
tasks.out_of_scope: No automatic public upload, cloud requirement, real-history samples or invented sanitization guarantees.
